steps.title: Pick your exam and language
steps.text: Choose the exam you are preparing for and whether you want the paper in English or Hindi.

steps.title: Take it like the real thing
steps.text: Each section has its own timer. When it ends, the section closes and you move on, just like exam day.

steps.title: Learn from every question
steps.text: See your score first, then a full analysis, then a solution for every question you got wrong.

sim.title: Real exam simulation
sim.text: Rules come from the exam itself. SSC CGL has four 15-minute sections you cannot return to. Other exams can allow moving between sections, and we follow whichever rule applies.
sim.more: More exams are on the way.

items.title: Summary
items.text: Your score and how many questions you attempted in each subject.

items.title: Analysis
items.text: Time per question, slowest questions and a comparison with your last attempt.

items.title: Question review
items.text: The solution, where you went wrong and how to improve, for every question.

items.title: Strong and weak areas
items.text: What to keep doing and what to practise next.

improve.title: See yourself improve
improve.text: Every attempt is compared with your last one, so you can see the marks you gained. A daily streak and activity map keep you consistent.

items.q: Does it work on a phone?
items.a: Yes. Exams run on phones and laptops. Some checks, such as full screen, work differently on some phones.
It checks that you are the only person in the frame. The video is not saved.
Choose it before a real exam starts. In practice you can switch any time.

items.q: What if I submit by mistake?
items.a: You can undo within 60 seconds, up to two times. Each undo counts as one warning.
